## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features
* Add `GitHubCopilotOAuthFlow` for device authorization by @Kludex in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8618
* Add `BoolCriteria` to say what a `bool` field's yes and no mean, and let a `True`/`False` `Enum` do the same by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8586
* Use what the user wrote about `None` as the "none of these" option in `TypeSafeModel` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8684
* Offer whole numbers that are not a rubric as a `Choice` in `TypeSafeModel` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8686
* Add `RealtimeSession.wait_for_reply()` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8514
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Keep all streamed `OpenAIChatModel` logprobs in `provider_details['logprobs']` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8653
* Allow `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6-luna`, and `gpt-6-astra` on Bedrock Converse by @sevakva in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8656
* fix: preserve fanned producer contributions in graph joins by @FIITAY in https://git
